places.name: Kunta Kinte-Alex Haley Memorial
places.summary: Sculpture, Story Wall and Compass Rose occupy the documented port where the Lord Ligonier arrived in 1767, converting a picturesque dock into a specific space for ancestry, bondage, resilience and contested public memory.
places.why_go: Sculpture, Story Wall and Compass Rose occupy the documented port where the Lord Ligonier arrived in 1767, converting a picturesque dock into a specific space for ancestry, bondage, resilience and contested public memory.
places.best_fit_note: Best fit: sheluvspaco and viki. Paco: shared reflection before dinner; Viki: waterfront sculpture with meaningful group-photo framing; Gora: specific African American port history; Stivka: human dignity and remembrance.

hours.note: Open public waterfront; best in daylight and fair weather.

places.exact_date_feasibility: An outdoor public memorial at City Dock, available after the State House closes. Sunset is later than the 17:40 finish in early October.
places.access_and_safety: Leave both cars in the same downtown garage used for the State House and walk. Watch busy dock traffic and wet edges; use well-lit streets back to the garage.
places.route_fit_note: Five-minute walk from the State House garage; no separate car detour.

places.name: The Breakers
places.summary: The Vanderbilt family’s 70-room summer house uses an Italian-palace shell to hide the machinery and labor that made Gilded Age life possible.
places.why_go: It combines theatrical rooms, Atlantic grounds, and the less-polished story of the workers and systems behind the spectacle.
places.best_fit_note: Viki gets the rooms and architecture; Gora gets the machinery, labor, and money story behind them.

hours.note: Reserve the first practical admission and recheck restoration access.

places.name: Beinecke Rare Book & Manuscript Library
places.summary: A windowless 1963 library whose thin marble walls glow amber around a six-story glass tower of rare books.
places.why_go: This is the compact, high-impact architectural stop the group unanimously rated 5: a stone box outside and a luminous book vault inside.
places.best_fit_note: The room delivers rare books, extraordinary light, and strange architecture without demanding a long detour or visit.

hours.note: Monday public exhibition hours; keep the 17:30–18:25 visit.

places.name: O Museum in The Mansion
places.summary: Five connected townhouses form a self-guided maze of more than 100 rooms, collections, and dozens of hidden doors.
places.why_go: It turns the group into active participants: everyone searches, opens panels, and compares discoveries instead of simply reading labels.
places.best_fit_note: The architecture and secret-door hunt give every traveler something to discover together.

hours.note: Saturday hours; buy an advance timed experience.

places.name: Princeton University Chapel
places.summary: A monumental 1928 collegiate Gothic chapel of stone arches, stained glass, and an unexpectedly immense interior.
places.why_go: It is a short, quiet counterweight to the route’s games and spectacle, placed directly on the northbound line.
places.best_fit_note: Stivka gets a reflective sacred stop and Viki gets one of the route’s strongest architectural interiors.
